study type: Cohort and Emulated Target Trial Protocol
exposure: mode of delivery (caesarean section, vaginal birth)
cohort: The study aims to analyze data from very preterm babies recorded in the National Neonatal Research Database (NNRD).
finding: This protocol aims to identify and obtain quantitative evidence to inform a future definitive clinical trial determining the optimal mode of delivery in preterm birth.
mod_finding: The protocol will investigate whether birth by caesarean section may protect against intraventricular haemorrhage in very preterm babies.
